caption: The video captures an outdoor yard on a partly cloudy day, where a fire is already burning at the base of a brush pile in the center foreground. A weathered wooden barn stands to the left, and a large leafy tree fills the center and right, its lower branches hovering above the flames. Behind the pile sits a pale shipping container, with blue barrels and a blue tarp to its left, a stack of lumber to its right, a dark SUV parked under the tree, and a round metal tank at the far right. The orange flames flicker and reshape continuously, their height varying as they rise and fall above the brush. A translucent plume of smoke drifts upward and slightly right from the fire, its density and position shifting as the burn continues. The brush pile, barn, tree, vehicle, container, and tank remain in place, and the camera viewpoint remains essentially fixed. The fire persists as an ongoing burn, and the flames and smoke carry the main motion across the otherwise still scene.
